note: Author's recommended scorecard. Categories follow the common review areas: infrastructure, security, MLOps, team and governance. The 0 to 3 scale, weights and default target are the author's heuristics.

criteria.text: GPU and node inventory exists and utilisation is measured
Network and storage paths for the workload are known and tested
A scheduler or orchestrator places workloads on accelerators
Identity and access control for users and services
Secrets are managed outside code and images
Quality is evaluated against a scored sample before release
A pipeline deploys and rolls back model changes
Latency, errors and quality are monitored in production
Team can operate Kubernetes in production
Team can diagnose GPU and driver failures
Audit trail of access and model changes
Data lineage and ownership are recorded
Change and release approval process is defined
